# Baron Pit — Engagement Pack: Build Spec for the 5 Approved Features

**Approved by Jay:** 2026-11-26 ("Add all 5"). **Art:** generated by Lyris via Runway 2026-11-26, masters in `docs/art/` (see §6 inventory). **Prerequisite:** the round-3 §0 reconciliation — this spec targets the *current production codebase*, not the stale snapshot. **Design law:** `THREADS-PARITY-STANDARD.md` — every item below is placed inside the existing feed/profile/room grammar; nothing here adds a top-level destination.

Evidence base (live tour, 2026-11-26): home feed has 2 posts; /questions is empty; /lfg is a coming-soon notice; /rooms is a text-only list; the most engaging surfaces are the player page, room banners, and the room pulse. This pack attacks exactly those gaps.

---

## 1. Animated game cards

**What:** the existing game-share card post kind gains a living background: a short looping video behind/above the card's stat block — victory loop (Baron rises, violet energy) or defeat loop (pit darkens to embers), chosen from the game's result already stored in the snapshot (`win` on the match summary).
**Placement:** inside the card post in the feed and on /player's last-3 rows (muted, autoplay, loop, `prefers-reduced-motion` respected — show the static hero art instead). No new surface.
**Build notes:**
- Assets: `docs/art/game-card-loop-victory-runway.mp4` / `game-card-loop-defeat-runway.mp4` → produce web copies in `public/` (≤ ~1.5 MB each; transcode to webm+mp4, 720p is plenty at card size) + poster frames (the existing emblem/hero art or a video frame).
- Render only when the card is in/near the viewport (IntersectionObserver) and pause off-screen — the perf budget in round-3 L3 still applies.
- Data: no schema change; `data` JSONB on the card post already carries the game; add `data.motion: "victory" | "defeat"` at post creation from the match result.
**Acceptance:** a posted win shows the victory loop, a loss the defeat loop; reduced-motion users see a still; feed scroll stays smooth (no long tasks from video decode on the main thread beyond decode defaults).

## 2. Room art set + rooms index life

**What:** every broad room gets a banner in the same painterly family as the existing pit/Ashe banners, and the rooms index stops being a text list.
**Assets (masters in `docs/art/`, web copies to `public/rooms/`):**
- New Players → `room-banner-new-players-runway.png` (sunlit path, ward lanterns, the pit ahead)
- Off-Meta Lab → `room-banner-off-meta-lab-runway.png` (alchemist bench over the pit)
- Patch & Meta → `room-banner-patch-meta-runway.png` (stone strategy table over the pit)
- The Baron Pit (seasonal, December) → `baron-pit-winter-banner-runway.png` (frozen pit, snowfall, lantern light). Seasonal swap is a config value (room slug → banner + season window), defaulting back to `baron-hero.png` after the window.
**Build notes:**
- Room header component takes the banner from the same map the broad-room definitions already use; champion rooms keep their Data Dragon splashes.
- **Rooms index:** each featured room row gains its banner thumbnail (small, rounded), member count, and a one-line latest-activity hint (last post time or room pulse games count — both already computed elsewhere). Search list stays clean text.
- **Fix the blank-load:** banners must reserve their box (aspect-ratio + background tint from the theme) and load with `fetchpriority` on the room header — the tour observed banners painting as blank white space first.
**Acceptance:** /rooms shows art + counts for all featured rooms; every broad room header shows its banner with no blank flash; winter banner serves on /rooms/general during December and reverts cleanly.

## 3. The Daily Call

**What:** a daily ritual poll. Each morning the system account posts one playful prediction poll ("The Call") into The Baron Pit room and pins it in the home feed's quiet module slot: e.g. "Baron or dragon at 20?", "Does the 0/3 Yasuo pop off by 15?" Next morning, a payoff post reports the result ("The pit called it — 68% said Baron. The pit was right. 🟣") and the new Call opens.
**Placement:** a poll post (existing kind) + the existing Make-the-Call banner treatment; payoff is a normal text post from the system account. No new page.
**Build notes:**
- Reuse the patch-watch cron pattern: a daily cron route (CRON_SECRET-gated, like `/api/cron/patch-watch`) that (a) closes yesterday's Call — reads its poll tallies, posts the payoff with the winning option and %; (b) opens today's Call from a rotating question bank (store the bank in code; ~30 questions, no repeats within 30 days — track last-used in `wp_meta` like `last_patch`).
- Questions are community/prediction flavor, never about a named player's skill (Riot walls: no shaming). Keep them patch-agnostic so the bank survives patches; a few slots can be patch-week specials.
- Votes use the existing poll system (changeable vote, tallies in `postViews`).
**Acceptance:** Call posts daily without manual action; payoff math matches the actual tallies; a missed day (cron failure) doesn't double-post on recovery (idempotency key in `wp_meta`, e.g. `last_call_date`).

## 4. Live form — streak flair + "Tonight in the pit"

**What:** surface the energy the room pulse already proved engaging, in two quiet places.
**Build notes:**
- **Streak flair:** extend `earnedBadges()` (pure.ts) usage — it already computes win streaks. Add a *current streak* chip rendered next to a player's name in feed/profile when their last ≥3 games are all wins ("3-win streak 🔥"). Positive-only by construction: cold streaks are never displayed on anyone else; a player's own /player page may keep the existing self-facing "cooling off" read.
- **Tonight in the pit:** one aggregate line in the home column (under the objective strip, same quiet styling): games played today by linked/looked-up players in the snapshot store, overall W–L, and the most-played champion with its win rate — e.g. "Tonight in the pit: 41 games · 23W–18L · Ashe 60%". Source: aggregate over `wp_players` snapshots refreshed today (same jsonb aggregation style as the room pulse). If the day's sample is < 10 games, show the trailing-7-days version labeled as such — never show a sad little number.
- Both are computed from data already retained (recent-form snapshots); **no new storage, no archive** — the aggregates are computed on read, exactly like the room pulse.
**Acceptance:** streak chip appears/disappears correctly as snapshots refresh; the home line matches a hand-checked aggregate; small-sample fallback triggers correctly.

## 5. The ward mascot

**What:** the site's character — a golden ward totem with the Baron's violet eye (`docs/art/ward-mascot-runway.png`, Runway task 6aa54b86, approved by Jay as part of this pack). One character, used consistently, always small and quiet (parity standard: it's content, not chrome).
**Usage map (implement exactly these, no mascot sprawl):**
- **Empty states:** feed-with-no-posts, empty room, no questions yet, no search results — mascot at ~72px + the existing one-line text + one action (per parity §6). This directly addresses /questions and the two-post feed reading as "dead."
- **Loading placeholder:** room banners and media use a mascot-tinted placeholder block instead of blank white (pairs with §2's fix).
- **Daily objective + Daily Call face:** the small mascot sits beside the objective strip and signs the Call payoff post's avatar (system account avatar → mascot crop).
- **404 / error pages:** mascot + "The pit is quiet here." + link home.
**Build notes:** produce web copies: full art for empty states (`public/mascot.png`), a tight square crop of the head/eye for the system-account avatar (`public/mascot-avatar.png`). Alt text: "The Baron Pit ward mascot". Never animate it into chrome (top bar stays the emblem).

## 7. Order and riders

Build order: §5 empty states + §2 art (fastest life-per-hour; they make the site feel inhabited today) → §3 Daily Call (the daily heartbeat) → §4 live form → §1 animated cards (heaviest perf care).
Rider from the tour: unify the patch label — /champions shows "16.23.1" (Data Dragon version) while the rest of the site shows "26.23" (display patch). One display format everywhere; keep the DD version only in code.
Definition of done per item: the round-3 standard (tests/typecheck/lint/build/live smoke) **plus** the parity checklist (standard §7) reported in the summary to Jay.
